findings.title: Wait for the reader to finish before checking its exceptions
findings.body: Setting deletedAll only requests that the reader stop; a groups(...) request can still be in flight when caughtExceptions is checked. If that request fails, its exception can be added after the assertion has passed, allowing this regression test to miss the concurrent-access failure it is intended to detect. Retain the reader Thread and join it before asserting that no exceptions were collected.

findings.title: Stop the background reader when deletion fails
findings.body: If any group removal throws, execution skips deletedAll.set(true), leaving the non-daemon reader running indefinitely. The reader catches request failures and continues, so realm/client teardown does not stop it and can instead turn it into a loop accumulating exceptions throughout the remaining test suite. Signal termination in a finally block and ensure the reader is joined on failure as well as success.
